comparisons.reason: Feature 0 flags any concrete, specific, checkable example (person, event, place, personal situation) used to support the counter-argument, whether or not it is a comparison. Feature 1 requires a concrete analogy: a real-world case from outside the OP's scenario, used as a comparison to the issue. Feature 1 is narrower, since it needs analogical use, an external case and a real-world factual basis. Feature 0 also counts personal or local situations and examples that are not analogies, including ones inside the OP's scenario. Feature 1 excludes restated OP examples. The eligibility rules differ, so the extraction functions differ.
